* Strong experience processing and analyzing large-scale multimodal datasets.

* Proficiency with Python (Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, sklearn) and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX).

* Experience with large-scale model training on GPUs and distributed systems.

* Strong work ethic with the ability to perform tasks independently.

* Proficient in analysis, presentation, and documentation of scientific data and scientific reports.

* Effective communicator with excellent interpersonal skills.

* Strong project management and organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask.

***Additional Preferred Qualifications:***

* Experience with genomics (single-cell RNA-seq, single-cell ATAC-seq) or imaging datasets.

* Experience with cross-domain representation learning or other multimodal learning approaches.

* Track record of applying deep learning frameworks to scientific questions, as shown by publications in high impact journals or machine learning conferences.
